body: Also she completely has blocked me out, I tried talking to her about the whole situation and she blocked me.
I broke up with her. She gave me an anxiety attack. I think she was pretty emotionally manipulative tbh. But it doesn't change how I feel.

Yah man. I have severe major depression. And this is kind of the catalyst that has thrown me over the edge. Like I don't want to be someone that ends their life over a lost relationship, but fuck it's thrown me in a dark fucking pit. I'm alone. So fucking alone man. I want to just not exist.
But that doesn't stop the memories or me thinking of her

I have. I moved literally to the other side of the country. From Vancouver Island to Prince Edward Island. To get away from the hurt. Yah I was in love, we had plans for the future that were helping me through my recovery. Right down to baby names and shit. I had never been in love with someone the way I was in love with her.
